chapters.title: The loop already exists
lines: Every business moves through a loop of people, decisions, and learning.
A signal arrives from a customer, a market, or an operational team.
Someone turns it into a question worth answering.
Others shape a plan, deliver a change, and examine the outcome.
What they learn becomes the starting point for the next cycle.

chapters.title: A Duet for every person
lines: Now imagine a Duet beside every person in that loop.
In our fictional example, customers find the next card activation step unclear.
A researcher asks their Duet to review the feedback.
It organises evidence, asks focused questions, and prepares a working summary.
The researcher brings judgment. Duet brings help that stays with the work.
Each colleague has their own Duet, with their own context.

chapters.title: From signal to a decision
lines: The researcher shares the finding with the business analysis team.
Together, the analyst and their Duet turn it into a clear user story.
Make the next activation step easy to understand.
They refine the scope, the customer journey, and the acceptance criteria.
The document evolves through conversation, review, and correction.
The business owner considers value, dependencies, and available capacity.
They decide what to take forward, and what to leave for later.
Duet keeps the decision, supporting material, and next action connected.

chapters.title: Make the handoff explicit
lines: Message Center makes that handoff explicit.
The analyst's Duet publishes the agreed story to the selected audience.
One message carries its source, its files, and its delivery status.
The receiving Duets bring relevant updates to their owners.
Questions and feedback travel back, so the conversation can continue.
It connects information to people, and people to the next step.

chapters.title: Connect the whole cycle
lines: The Scrum Master's Duet brings the requirements together and highlights dependencies.
Through approved channels, it consults the developers' Duets.
Each person confirms the scope and commitments that belong to them.
Complex work can be delegated, with results returned for review.
Plans, files, and test evidence stay connected to the task.
People decide whether the outcome meets the agreed acceptance criteria.
Production integration is a future step, with release decisions kept under human control.
An update can then be published through Message Center.
Operational feedback returns to research: where does uncertainty remain?
The result of one cycle becomes the question for the next.

chapters.title: Grow the partnership
lines: Each cycle can deepen the partnership.
Corrections, preferences, and project context become reusable memory.
Duet reviews experience and brings that knowledge into future work.
Imagine its share of suitable work growing from ten, to fifty, to ninety-five percent.
An illustrative ambition, not measured performance.
Progress depends on proven capability and explicit authority.
People keep key decisions; Duet takes on more routine execution.
Each cycle begins with greater understanding.

chapters.title: A business that keeps learning
lines: Across the organisation, people lead.
Duets coordinate through approved connections.
Message Center carries signals and outcomes.
Every person, a Duet. Every handoff, a connection.
Every cycle, a better business.
Duet. A human-led, AI-native organisation.
